benagil-cave.alt: Benagil Cave from above: the round skylight in the clifftop, turquoise water and the hidden beach below, and tour boats waiting outside the western arch
benagil-cave.caption: The eye of Benagil from the clifftop. Every visit now happens from the water: boats at the western arch, guided kayaks at the eastern one.

benagil-cave-tour-operators.alt: Tour boats and kayaks lined up on Benagil beach in the early morning before the first departures
benagil-cave-tour-operators.caption: Benagil beach before the first departures. The kayak and SUP operators launch from here; most boats leave from the towns either side.

is-benagil-cave-worth-it.alt: The view from a tour boat paused at the western arch of Benagil Cave: empty beach inside, skylight above, other boats waiting outside
is-benagil-cave-worth-it.caption: What a boat visit is now: two minutes at the arch, an empty beach nobody may land on, and the next boat waiting.

benagil-cave-tour-from-carvoeiro.alt: Carvoeiro's beach cove with white houses on the cliffs and small Benagil tour boats loading at the water's edge
benagil-cave-tour-from-carvoeiro.caption: Carvoeiro: the boats load straight off the town beach, and the cave is a quarter of an hour east.

benagil-cave-tour-from-armacao-de-pera.alt: A painted fishing boat and a tour RIB on the sand at Armacao de Pera, the closest big beach to Benagil
benagil-cave-tour-from-armacao-de-pera.caption: Armação de Pêra: launches off the beach beside the fishing boats, the closest big-town start to the cave.

benagil-cave-tour-from-portimao.alt: Speedboats loading passengers at Portimao marina with the Praia da Rocha cliffs beyond
benagil-cave-tour-from-portimao.caption: Portimão marina: the RIB fleet with the biggest review counts on the coast leaves from these pontoons.

benagil-cave-tour-from-albufeira.alt: A tour catamaran ready to leave Albufeira marina, with the marina's pastel buildings behind
benagil-cave-tour-from-albufeira.caption: Albufeira marina: the catamaran and dolphin combos start here, an hour's cruise east of the cave.

benagil-cave-tour-from-lagos.alt: A tour boat among the sea stacks of Ponta da Piedade near Lagos on the way to Benagil
benagil-cave-tour-from-lagos.caption: Lagos trips pass Ponta da Piedade first; the cave is the far turnaround, 45 to 60 minutes out.

benagil-cave-access-rules.alt: Diagram of the Benagil Cave access rules: boats two minutes by the western arch, guided kayaks eight minutes by the eastern entrance, no landing, no swimming
benagil-cave-access-rules.caption: The 2024 rules in one picture: boats by the western arch for two minutes, guided paddlers by the eastern entrance for eight, nobody on the sand.

benagil-cave-sea-conditions.alt: Gauge of the swell thresholds for Benagil Cave: calm under 0.5 metres, choppy to 1.5 metres, closed above 1.5 metres
benagil-cave-sea-conditions.caption: The one number that decides the day. The live reading at the top of this page uses the same three bands.

benagil-boat-tour-comparison.alt: Comparison chart of the four ways to visit Benagil Cave: speedboat, small boat, catamaran and guided kayak, by duration, price, and minutes inside
benagil-boat-tour-comparison.caption: Four ways in. Every motorised boat gets the same two minutes; only a guided paddle gets eight.

benagil-cave-kayak-route.alt: Route diagram of a guided kayak visit to Benagil Cave: launch from Benagil beach, paddle 150 to 200 metres, enter by the eastern entrance for up to eight minutes
benagil-cave-kayak-route.caption: The paddle itself is short. The eight minutes inside are the whole point.

benagil-cave-departure-towns-map.alt: Schematic map of the Algarve coast showing one-way sea times to Benagil Cave from Lagos, Portimao, Carvoeiro, Armacao de Pera and Albufeira
benagil-cave-departure-towns-map.caption: One-way sea times, approximate. The closest launches spend the most of your trip at the cave.

benagil-cave-light-window.alt: Cross-section of Benagil Cave showing when sunlight falls through the skylight: soft early light, a direct beam from 10:00 to 13:00, and soft late-afternoon light
benagil-cave-light-window.caption: The beam is a light-viewing window, not a legal one. The access rules cap craft and minutes, not the clock.

benagil-cave-worth-it-verdict.alt: Chart of what a Benagil visit gets you now: two minutes by boat, eight minutes by guided kayak, and the old beach landing and swim-in banned since August 2024
benagil-cave-worth-it-verdict.caption: Set the expectation before you book: it is a from-the-water visit, and the paddle is the long one.

benagil-cave-kayak-vs-sup.alt: Comparison of kayak and stand-up paddleboard tours into Benagil Cave: stability, viewpoint, sea conditions and starting prices
benagil-cave-kayak-vs-sup.caption: Same entrance, same eight minutes. The board buys the viewpoint; the kayak buys the stability.

benagil-boat-tour.alt: A small speedboat pausing at the western mouth of Benagil cave, with the round skylight and turquoise water inside
benagil-boat-tour.caption: The western arch: the only way in for a motorised boat, and a two-minute visit whatever you arrive on.

benagil-cave-kayak-tour.alt: Tandem kayaks with a guide entering Benagil cave through the eastern arch under the skylight beam
benagil-cave-kayak-tour.caption: The eastern entrance, single file, one guide per six craft: eight minutes under the eye.

benagil-boat-tour-comparison-towns.alt: Comparison chart of the four ways to visit Benagil Cave: speedboat, small boat, catamaran and guided kayak, by duration, where they leave from, and minutes inside
benagil-boat-tour-comparison-towns.caption: Four ways in. Every motorised boat gets the same two minutes; only a guided paddle gets eight. Live prices are on the cards below.
